title: Harbor Security Hub
description: Harbor Security Hub: registry-wide vulnerability totals, where a CVE is, and what a project has to fix first.

panels.title: Critical findings
panels.description: Findings summed over every scanned artifact; one CVE in N artifacts counts N times.

targets.root_selector: $append([{"kind": "summary", "critical_cnt": critical_cnt, "high_cnt": high_cnt, "medium_cnt": medium_cnt, "low_cnt": low_cnt, "fixable_cnt": fixable_cnt, "scanned_cnt": scanned_cnt, "total_artifact": total_artifact}], $append(dangerous_cves.{"kind": "cve", "cve_id": cve_id, "severity": severity, "cvss_score_v3": cvss_score_v3, "package": package, "version": version}, dangerous_artifacts.{"kind": "artifact", "project_id": project_id, "repository_name": repository_name, "digest": digest, "a_critical": critical_cnt, "a_high": high_cnt, "a_medium": medium_cnt}))

panels.title: Scan coverage
panels.description: Artifacts with a default-scanner report / all artifact rows. The denominator includes signatures, SBOMs and index children, so this is a lower bound.

panels.title: Top 5 dangerous CVEs
panels.description: Click a CVE to see every repository it affects.

panels.title: Top 5 dangerous artifacts
panels.description: Click a repository to open its project.

options.content: **Drill down:** open **CVE lookup** or **Project** below and pick the CVE ID or project at the top, or click a CVE or repository above to fill them in. Data is live from the Harbor Security Hub API; the time range has no effect.

panels.title: Repositories affected by $cve
panels.description: Empty means no scanned artifact carries the CVE. Capped at 1000 findings.

panels.title: CVEs in ${project:text} ($severity)
panels.description: Sorted by artifacts affected: fixing the top rows cleans the most artifacts. Capped at 1000 findings.
